name: What are the most common kitchen layouts and their benefits?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common kitchen layouts and their benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen layouts include the L-shaped, U-shaped, galley, and single-wall designs. An L-shaped kitchen is versatile and great for open concepts, offering efficient workspace. U-shaped kitchens provide abundant counter and storage space, ideal for larger families. Galley kitchens are efficient for small spaces, with two parallel countertops. Single-wall kitchens are best for very compact areas, maximizing open floor space. The best layout depends on your home's structure and your family's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common kitchen layouts are L-shaped, U-shaped, galley, and single-wall. Each offers distinct benefits in terms of space, storage, and workflow.
